card.name: Linking words right after died
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as without, and, before or of that come straight after died, death or dying. The pole responds to the word that continues the sentence after the death is stated.

modes.label: without after died
modes.description: The word without follows a verb of dying and introduces what was missing at death.
modes.example: Mohammed died<< without>> a single enemy left standing.

modes.label: and after died
modes.description: A joining word follows died and links to what happened next.
modes.example: Ramesses XI died<< and>> ended the 20th Dynasty and

modes.label: other death phrases
modes.description: A short word follows death or dying, such as of or on.
modes.example: 3, after the death<< of>> caliph Al-Amin the palace was

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mixed and suggest little beyond a loose sense of being left behind or surviving.
